Method of Attack: Encryption flaw in the ransomware encryptor allowing creation of a Windows decryptor to recover files for free
Uses a faulty random number generator (CSPRNG) seeded from system time to generate encryption keys, making keys guessable
Intermittent encryption of files (only parts encrypted, others left plaintext)
Counter-mode (CTR) encryption process allowing symmetric encryption and decryption
Discoverer: South Korean researchers including Korean Internet & Security Agency (KISA)
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection targeting various industries including healthcare, military, cultural, and energy
Indicators of Compromise: Technical paper and automated Windows decryptor tool published on KISA's website
Warnings issued by FBI and CISA in November 2023
